svg.title: Agent Skills Specification Overview
svg.desc: Diagram showing the official Agent Skills open standard: directory structure, SKILL.md frontmatter fields, progressive disclosure tiers, and ecosystem relationships.
svg.text: Originally by Anthropic · Dec 2025 · Adopted by Claude, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, VS Code and 20+ others

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does progressive disclosure work in Agent Skills?')
g.text: name + description only (~100 tokens). Always loaded.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('When does an agent load the full SKILL.md body?')
g.text: Full SKILL.md body. Loaded when skill is activated.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What goes in the references and scripts folders?')
g.text: scripts/, references/, assets/. Loaded on demand.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What are the rules for the SKILL.md name field?')
sendPrompt('How do I write a good description for a skill?')

svg.text: Max 1024 chars. Explain what the skill
does AND when to trigger it.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How should I specify a license for my skill?')

svg.text: License name or reference to a bundled

g.onclick: sendPrompt('When should I use the compatibility field in SKILL.md?')
sendPrompt('What can I put in the metadata field?')

svg.text: version, org. Unique key names recommended.
